messages.content: Suppose a sequence of polynomials B_n(x) converge pointwise to f(x) on [0, 1]. Does it follow that the B_n converge uniformly? Ensure that stop words constitute no more than 20% of the total words in your response.

message.content: No. Pointwise convergence does not imply uniform convergence. Counterexample: Let $B_n(x) = x^n$ on [0, 1]. Each polynomial converges pointwise to discontinuous limit $f(x)$ (0 for x<1, 1 at x=1). Uniform limits of continuous functions must be continuous. Since $f$ discontinuous, convergence cannot be uniform. Thus, no.
